# Let's Skydive HK

> Hong Kong-based skydiving booking platform offering tandem skydives and A-Licence training at dropzones across Thailand (Pattaya, Chiang Mai) and China (Huizhou, Hainan, Luoding, Zhuhai).

Let's Skydive HK helps Hong Kong jumpers book tandem skydives and progress to a full A-Licence at partner dropzones in Asia. Pricing, schedules, and deposits are managed online with a $500 HKD Airwallex deposit. Participants must be 18+ and under 100kg.
